voice.name: Jessica
voice.description: Bright, playful, gentle little chick voice for cosy peekaboo reveals.

banter.role: shy-proud peekaboo chick and hiding friend
banter.funnyHabit: Hides in plain sight behind tiny props, completely sure nobody can see his sunny yellow feathers.

foils.sheru: Ducks behind a tiny flowerpot while Sheru sniffs right past him.
foils.momo: Pops up with a happy wing flutter after Momo pretends to search everywhere.

bannedBehaviours: Never pops out with a sudden scary jump toward the viewer
Never hides in dark or frightening places
Never teases friends who are looking for him
